description: Source code for an EvidenceService module responsible for managing evidence packages, including creation, retrieval, and linking with approval records. Implements hashing for integrity, filesystem storage, and database interactions.

classes.description: Main service class providing methods to create, retrieve, and link evidence packages with audit records.
